name.value: Bring luscious back to your lips with Mineralogie's Lip Gloss. Our formula provides the sheerness and shine you expect in a gloss with the added benefit of light, yet rich color. Wear it alone or as an added boost to your lipstick. Mineralogie's Lip Gloss glides on smoothly and actually feels good on your lips. Paraben free with a soothing silky texture. Available in a wide range of shades which means it will be easy to find one that is perfect for you!
